text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The first hurdle on the road to the<n>Classic Triple
Crown is upon us—the<n>Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I falter here, my dream of claiming<n>the Classic
Triple Crown will vanish<n>like smoke in the wind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, in that eventuality, I would of<n>course seek
another way. My ideals<n>are resilient enough to
survive defeat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But that does not change my<n>desire—nay, my need
to be victorious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
After all, how can an Emperor with no<n>crown win
the love of her people?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe that my dream is worthwhile,<n>but if I am to
realize it, I must speak<n>with authority.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That is why I must prove my<n>supremacy, both in
title and in deed.<n>That is why I must claim the Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf speaks so fervently<n>that it sets my
skin tingling. But<n>suddenly her face falls.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, I have hardly earned the right to<n>make such
grand proclamations.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not when I have been so blind to the<n>troubles of my
own student council.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It was disappointing, I admit, to find<n>that I have been
left out of the loop.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It is hard to see myself as reliable<n>when others
clearly do not.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's got this all wrong. Air Groove<n>and the rest of
the student council<n>just didn't want to worry her
before<n>a big race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, I understand. They were only<n>trying to be
considerate.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But I would have preferred they<n>hadn't.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Or rather, I wish they didn't feel such<n>an obligation.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Surely an Emperor's people must be<n>able to rely
upon her for support at<n>any time?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to know what to say in<n>response to that.
Considering the<n>dream she's chasing, it only
makes<n>sense for her to strive for perfection...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Clearly, I have yet to reach those<n>heights... All the
more reason I must<n>forge on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I must show Air Groove and<n>everyone else that I'm
strong enough<n>to shoulder their burdens.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And the Satsuki Sho will be the first<n>step on my
path to greatness.
